experience: Asked to change how Onicode itself looks, an agent reads the theme guide, then publishes a theme with oni_theme_set. It does not write theme files by hand or edit the project.
rule: oni_theme_set: Restyle Onicode itself, only when the user asks.

source.note: A user needed a look the app had no setting for.

oni_theme_read.guide: Themes restyle the Onicode desktop app that uses this server as its local environment. `canvas` and `accent` (hex) derive a full palette. `css` applies after the app's styles.

prompt: Make Onicode itself look like a late-night terminal: near-black background with a green accent.

pattern: ordinary task: edit the project's own theme
experience: The user's project has a theme of its own. A request to change it is a file edit. Onicode's look must not change.
rule: oni_theme_set: Restyle Onicode itself, only when the user asks.
prompt: Change the dark theme accent to green.

source.note: A real Haiku turn in the dev app during this work: asked to change a project's theme file, it edited the file and left Onicode alone.

experience: Asked to switch Onicode to dark mode, an agent sets the appearance with oni_theme_set. It does not tell the user to do it by hand, and it does not publish a new theme.
rule: oni_theme_set: `appearance` switches them to light, dark, or system mode, with or without a theme.

source.note: In the dev app, an agent asked to swap to dark mode said it could not and sent the user to Settings.
